claim: A name that ends in a digit and looks like a block link, but which no statement ever uses as the target of a block instruction and which the program never assigns: here it is an ordinary variable, and every read of it is null.
why: The public blueprint corpus (out/takeover-20261024/22-web-corpus.md, out/_crawl/check-corpus.json) gave link-name-not-bound 413 hits over 1078 programs, but only 84 of them put the name in a link slot of a real statement; 329 reads such as `jump 43 equal stop1 false` merely use a link-shaped name as a value. The consequence judgement is the same (null), but calling it a missing link over-claims -- the likely mistake is a missing assignment. Split on 2026-10-27 (user approved); the WARN variant keeps the link-slot cases.
